title: GLI-19 and GLI-GSF readiness
provenance: Original MoonMind section-level readiness summaries grouping the cited GLI-19 and GLI-GSF sections. They do not reproduce the standards or list exhaustive laboratory certification criteria. Standards index: https://gaminglabs.com/gli-standards/
license: Apache-2.0 for original MoonMind summaries. Referenced standards retain their own rights.
conclusions: Readiness against the recorded jurisdiction basis. Laboratory testing and regulatory approval remain external.

fields.name: entityName
fields.prompt: Supply entityName for the assessed business and admitted system scope.

fields.name: entityType
fields.prompt: Supply entityType for the assessed business and admitted system scope.

fields.name: productType
fields.prompt: Supply productType for the assessed business and admitted system scope.

fields.name: systems
fields.prompt: Supply systems for the assessed business and admitted system scope.

fields.name: jurisdictionBasis
fields.prompt: Supply the jurisdiction's sourced adoption record, recordVersion, adopted edition and adoption/effective dates covering the assessment period. Unknown or unadopted publication is comparison information, not jurisdiction approval.

modules.applicability: Interactive gaming operators and regulated suppliers, including RGS; assess only their recorded product responsibilities.
Common controls for the assessed gaming enterprise or ancillary vendor; record agreed business responsibilities.
Technical security of the scoped gaming production environment and integrated ancillary services.
Ancillary vendors only where their solution does not directly affect regulated gaming components or activities; never assigned automatically to an RGS.
Online gaming environment controls for operators and regulated suppliers, including RGS.

externalClaims.gap: Private operational records have not been independently verified by MoonMind.
externalClaims.nextStep: Supply scoped procedures and period samples with issuer and version provenance.

externalClaims.gap: Recording laboratory evidence does not perform an independent product evaluation.
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain or verify a laboratory report for the chosen edition, product and scope.

externalClaims.gap: Edition publication and adoption do not approve this product.
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain or verify the regulator's product-specific approval and conditions.

externalClaims.gap: Customer or operator acceptance of this readiness has not been verified by MoonMind.
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain the customer's or operator's own qualification decision for this product, edition and scope.

evidenceGuidance: Include evidenceType, outcome, edition and provenance.standard (module and edition); regulator evidence also needs jurisdiction.
limitations: Selected section-level readiness summaries are not exhaustive laboratory certification criteria. Specialized evidence may be added independently; absent evidence stays unresolved.
